item.title: Bulletin updated at 06:05 HKT 30/May/2025
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
A trough of low pressure will bring a few showers to the northern part of the South China Sea today. Meanwhile, a strong easterly airstream will affect the coastal areas today and tomorrow. A southwesterly airstream is expected to bring hot and showery weather to the coast of southern China early next week. Another trough of low pressure will edge closer to southern China midweek next week. The weather will become unsettled over the region.
